narrative: The morning after: butter firkins on a stall, a market measure, a mended shutter, a constable with a bill leaning by them. He is bored. The firkins are set out as on any Saturday. Nothing is broken. Nobody argues with him. No crowd.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Stood at the edge of the stall and then went home.

entities.name: Leadenhall
entities.context: In photo: Firkins, a measure, a constable
